name: Photonics Lasers: Lasivane
subtitle: Photonics lasers optics course
shortDescription: Adaptive photonics and lasers course: beams, cavities, gain, pulses and polarisation, with five hands-on labs. Learning only, not laser-safety guidance.
longDescription:
Photonics Lasers: Lasivane is a self-paced course in optics and lasers for physics and photonics students, with five interactive labs you can drag, tune and check against the equations.

### Learn By Doing
- Beam Bench: drag lenses and watch a Gaussian beam focus, with its waist and Rayleigh range computed from ABCD matrices.
- Gain Pulse: pump a laser, see the threshold, the relaxation oscillations and the settled output.
- Cavity Rings: Fabry-Perot fringes, mode spacing, finesse and the modes that can lase.
- Pulse Forge: add cavity modes and watch locked phases build a short pulse.
- Polarisation Sphere: wave plates and polarisers on a 3D Poincare sphere.
Every lab shows a check line where the engine number meets an independent second calculation.

### A Course That Adapts
Fourteen topics: Gaussian beams, ABCD matrices and resonator stability, interference and coherence, Fabry-Perot cavities, diffraction gratings, polarisation and Jones calculus, Einstein coefficients and inversion, laser threshold and gain, resonator modes, mode-locking, optical fibre, dispersion, nonlinear optics basics, photodetectors and noise.
- About two hundred questions with worked solutions, each numeric answer re-computed by a second method.
- A personalised path that follows your weakest topic, or the syllabus order.
- A mock exam of ten numeric questions with no hints.
- Lesson pop-ups at school, college and graduate level.
- Sources for every lab and lesson open inside the app (textbooks, journal papers, society pages), link only.
- Text size buttons on every screen, calm motion option, works offline, no account.

### Free With Optional Ad Removal
Everything is free. Short ads appear between practice blocks, and you can watch an optional video for a credit. A monthly subscription (price shown in the App Store, 7-day free trial) removes ads; it renews automatically until cancelled in your Apple ID settings.

Educational physics only. This app is not laser-safety, eye-safety or engineering guidance and gives no hazard classes or exposure limits.
